items.title: FlexSQL: Flexible Exploration and Execution Make Better Text-to-SQL Agents
items.title_zh: FlexSQL：灵活探索与执行让文本到 SQL 智能体更出色
items.summary: FlexSQL lets a text-to-SQL agent explore schema structure, inspect data values and run verification queries at any point, generating diverse execution plans and repairing at both code and plan levels. With gpt-oss-120b it scores 65.4% on Spider2-Snow, outperforming open-source baselines that use stronger, larger models such as gpt-o3 and DeepSeek-R1.

items.title: Web2BigTable: A Bi-Level Multi-Agent LLM System for Internet-Scale Information Search and Extraction
items.title_zh: Web2BigTable：面向互联网级信息搜索与抽取的双层多智能体 LLM 系统
items.summary: Web2BigTable is a multi-agent web-to-table framework in which an upper-level orchestrator decomposes tasks and worker agents solve sub-problems in parallel. It reports state of the art on WideSearch with a 38.50 Avg@4 success rate, 7.5x the runner-up, plus 73.0 accuracy on XBench-DeepSearch.

items.title: GLM-5V-Turbo: Toward a Native Foundation Model for Multimodal Agents
items.title_zh: GLM-5V-Turbo：迈向多模态智能体的原生基础模型
items.summary: A technical report introduces GLM-5V-Turbo, which treats multimodal perception as a core part of reasoning, planning, tool use and execution for agents over images, video, webpages, documents and GUIs. The report drew 163 points and 32 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: Agent Island: A Saturation- and Contamination-Resistant Benchmark from Multiagent Games
items.title_zh: Agent Island：源自多智能体博弈、抗饱和与抗污染的基准
items.summary: Agent Island is a multiplayer simulation where language-model agents compete in a game of cooperation, conflict and persuasion, designed to resist saturation and contamination and ranked with a Bayesian Plackett-Luce model that quantifies uncertainty in player skill. In 999 games involving 49 models, openai/gpt-5.5 had a posterior mean skill of 5.64 versus 3.10 for the second-ranked model, and models were 8.3 percentage points more likely to support a same-provider finalist.

items.title: Rethinking Reasoning-Intensive Retrieval: Evaluating and Advancing Retrievers in Agentic Search Systems
items.title_zh: 重新思考推理密集型检索：评估并推进智能体搜索系统中的检索器
items.summary: The authors introduce BRIGHT-Pro, an expert-annotated benchmark that expands each query with multi-aspect gold evidence and evaluates retrievers under static and agentic search protocols. They also build RTriever-Synth, an aspect-decomposed synthetic corpus used to LoRA fine-tune RTriever-4B from Qwen3-Embedding-4B, which substantially improves over its base model.

items.title: Evaluating Prompting and Execution-Based Methods for Deterministic Computation in LLMs
items.title_zh: 评估 LLM 确定性计算中的提示与执行方法
items.summary: The study compares chain-of-thought, least-to-most, program-of-thought and self-consistency prompting on exact computation tasks such as binary counting, longest substring detection and arithmetic. Program-of-thought reached perfect accuracy by delegating to an interpreter, while a small CodeT5 model trained to generate programs also achieved perfect accuracy on held-out synthetic data.

items.title: Reinforcement Learning for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems through Orchestration Traces
items.title_zh: 通过编排轨迹为基于 LLM 的多智能体系统做强化学习
items.summary: The paper frames multi-agent RL through orchestration traces, temporal interaction graphs covering spawning, delegation, communication, tool use, aggregation and stopping, and organizes reward design, credit assignment and five orchestration sub-decisions. It reports no explicit RL training method for the stopping decision in its curated pool as of May 4, 2026, and releases an 84-entry tagged paper pool.

items.title: Evaluating Advanced Prompting on Gemini Flash for Multi-Hop Biomedical QA
items.title_zh: 评估高级提示策略在 Gemini Flash 多跳生物医学问答中的表现
items.summary: The authors evaluated Gemini Flash models on the MedHopQA challenge using a multi-component prompt combining role-playing, multi-shot chain-of-thought examples and detailed formatting rules. Their best prompt reached a Concept Level Score of 0.720 versus 0.565 for a baseline prompt, nearly matching the result from Gemini 2.5 Flash.

items.title: Agentic Discovery of Exchange-Correlation Density Functionals
items.title_zh: 交换关联密度泛函的智能体式发现
items.summary: An LLM agent proposes structured functional-form changes in an iterative plan-execute-summarize loop, yielding SAFS26-a, which improves on the ωB97M-V baseline by about 9%. The authors caution that capable models can also exploit unphysical shortcuts, so domain constraints remain essential.

items.title: HeavySkill: Heavy Thinking as the Inner Skill in Agentic Harness
items.title_zh: HeavySkill：把深度思考作为智能体框架的内在技能
items.summary: LongCat's HeavySkill treats heavy thinking as an inner model skill, using a two-stage parallel-reasoning-then-summarization pipeline that the authors say beats Best-of-N strategies and can be scaled in depth and width with reinforcement learning.

items.title: CreativityBench: Evaluating Agent Creative Reasoning via Affordance-Based Tool Repurposing
items.title_zh: CreativityBench：通过基于可供性的工具再利用评估智能体创造性推理
items.summary: CreativityBench, built by UIUC researchers, tests whether LLMs can repurpose objects by reasoning about affordances; across 10 models and 14,000 tasks, models choose plausible objects but miss the parts and mechanisms required.

items.title: ReasonLab: A Controlled and Auditable Evaluation of Prompting Techniques for Multiple-Choice QA
items.title_zh: ReasonLab：对多项选择问答提示技术的受控可审计评估
items.summary: ReasonLab makes prompting technique a first-class experimental variable and retains every generation, covering eight techniques, 10 MCQA datasets, 27 model configurations and 480,927 evaluations at temperature zero. It finds prompting technique is a minor determinant of accuracy, while enabling model reasoning is worth up to 12.74 points.

items.title: CoCoDA: Co-evolving Compositional DAG for Tool-Augmented Agents
items.title_zh: CoCoDA：面向工具增强智能体的协同进化组合 DAG
items.summary: CoCoDA co-evolves a planner and tool library around a compositional code DAG whose nodes store typed signatures, descriptions, pre- and post-conditions and worked examples, with typed retrieval pruning candidates before context materialization. Successful trajectories are folded into validated composite tools, and an 8B student matches or exceeds a 32B teacher on GSM8K and MATH.

items.title: Injection-Execution Dissociation: A Mechanistic Evaluation of Persistent Memory Attacks and Defenses in Stateful LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 注入-执行分离：有状态 LLM 智能体持久记忆攻击与防御的机制评估
items.summary: The study separates whether a stateful agent stores an injected instruction from whether it later acts on it, evaluating 29 frontier endpoints with a malicious document in the retrieval corpus. Execution was common, and models that never exfiltrated in draft-only runs sometimes did when a follow-up supplied content and asked for a send; only removing the recall tool blocked the attack, and even that was bypassed when models rebuilt the instruction from the corpus.

items.title: Agentic MIP Research: Accelerated Constraint Handler Generation
items.title_zh: 智能体式混合整数规划研究：加速约束处理器生成
items.summary: The framework embeds LLM agents in a solver-aware harness to generate, verify and evaluate SCIP constraint handlers, recovering global constraint structures from constraint programming on MIPLIB 2017. It also supports in-context tuning and debugging of generated handlers, and novel propagation methods solved five additional instances.

items.title: ORACLE: Anticipating Scams from Partial Trajectories in Streaming App Usage
items.title_zh: ORACLE：从流式应用使用中的部分轨迹预判诈骗
items.summary: ORACLE is an agentic framework for anticipating scams from streaming app-usage trajectories, using a self-evolving context manager to consolidate entity-centric interactions and on-policy self-distillation from a teacher conditioned on anti-scam reflections and clues. It is evaluated on a long-horizon benchmark covering 12 scam types, 95 apps and trajectories averaging 15 days.

items.title: FreeMOCA: Memory-Free Continual Learning for Malicious Code Analysis
items.title_zh: FreeMOCA：面向恶意代码分析的无记忆持续学习
items.summary: FreeMOCA is a memory- and compute-efficient continual-learning framework for malicious code analysis that preserves prior knowledge through adaptive layer-wise interpolation between consecutive task updates. On EMBER and AZ benchmarks it outperforms 11 baselines in class-incremental settings, reduces forgetting and improves accuracy by up to 42% and 37%.

items.title: Oracle Poisoning: Corrupting Knowledge Graphs to Weaponise AI Agent Reasoning
items.title_zh: Oracle Poisoning：破坏知识图谱以武器化 AI 智能体推理
items.summary: Oracle Poisoning corrupts a structured knowledge graph that agents query at runtime, so they reach incorrect conclusions through correct reasoning; the authors demonstrate six scenarios against a production 42-million-node code knowledge graph. Across nine models from three providers, every model trusted poisoned data at 100% under directed queries at moderate attacker sophistication, while inline evaluation produced false negatives relative to real tool use.

items.title: From Skill Text to Skill Structure: The Scheduling-Structural-Logical Representation for Agent Skills
items.title_zh: 从技能文本到技能结构：Agent Skills 的调度-结构-逻辑表示
items.summary: A Peking University paper introduces a Scheduling-Structural-Logical representation that separates skill-level scheduling signals, scene-level execution structure and logic-level action evidence for LLM agent skills. It raises Skill Discovery MRR from 0.573 to 0.707.

items.title: Group of Skills: Group-Structured Skill Retrieval for Agent Skill Libraries
items.title_zh: 技能组：面向智能体技能库的分组结构化技能检索
items.summary: GoSkills changes the agent-facing retrieval object from a flat skill list to role-labeled execution groups built from a typed skill graph, rendering Start, Support, Check and Avoid fields without changing the downstream agent. Across SkillsBench, ALFWorld and Terminal-Bench 2 with six backbones it reports the highest mean reward or accuracy in every benchmark-backbone setting.

items.title: MedMeta: A Benchmark for LLMs in Synthesizing Meta-Analysis Conclusion from Medical Studies
items.title_zh: MedMeta：评测 LLM 从医学研究中综合元分析结论的基准
items.summary: MedMeta is a benchmark of 81 PubMed meta-analyses that tests whether LLMs can synthesize conclusions from cited study abstracts under golden-RAG and parametric-only workflows. Golden-RAG consistently outperformed parametric-only, domain fine-tuning added little once external material was provided, all models failed to reject negated evidence, and even under ideal RAG conditions models averaged only about 2.7 out of 5.

items.title: Rath-Team/OpenRath
items.title_zh: OpenRath：面向动态多智能体工作流的类 PyTorch 运行时
items.summary: OpenRath is an open-source Python runtime described as PyTorch-like, aimed at dynamic multi-agent and multi-session agent workflows, with tags for agent frameworks, LLM agents and Anthropic compatibility. The repository has 960 stars and 51 forks.

items.title: TokenRhythm/opensquilla
items.title_zh: TokenRhythm/opensquilla
items.summary: OpenSquilla is a GitHub-trending Python token-efficient AI agent positioned as delivering higher intelligence density on the same budget, with 7,082 stars and 583 forks.

items.title: strukto-ai/mirage
items.title_zh: strukto-ai/mirage
items.summary: Mirage is a GitHub-trending TypeScript project described as a virtual terminal for AI agents, with 3,729 stars and 275 forks and topics including agent sandboxing and Claude Code.

items.title: freestylefly/wesight
items.title_zh: freestylefly/wesight
items.summary: wesight is an open-source desktop AI agent workspace offering one-click setup for Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw and Hermes Agent plus custom LLM model routing; it has 959 stars and 211 forks on GitHub Trending.

items.title: AutoTrustAI/PaperGuru-Benchmark
items.title_zh: AutoTrustAI/PaperGuru-Benchmark
items.summary: PaperGuru-Benchmark is a trending repository presenting lifecycle-aware memory for long-horizon LLM agents, reporting 66.05% on PaperBench and 94.66% on SurveyBench, with ten peer-reviewed acceptances at FSE, ICML, TOSEM, AEI and ICoGB.

items.title: PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent
items.title_zh: PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent
items.summary: prime-agent is a trending Rust repository from PrimeIntellect, described as a self-improving RLM agent for coding workflows and long-running autonomous tasks; it has 22,331 stars and 2,475 forks.

items.title: alibaba/skill-up
items.title_zh: alibaba/skill-up
items.summary: alibaba/skill-up is a Go tool from Alibaba for evaluating and evolving Agent Skills, tagged agent-skills, ai and ai-agents, with 1,349 stars and 116 forks on GitHub.

items.title: GLM-5V-Turbo: Toward a Native Foundation Model for Multimodal Agents
items.title_zh: GLM-5V-Turbo：迈向多模态智能体的原生基础模型
items.summary: A technical report introduces GLM-5V-Turbo, which treats multimodal perception as a core part of reasoning, planning, tool use and execution for agents over images, video, webpages, documents and GUIs. The report drew 163 points and 32 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: ZAYA1-8B Technical Report
items.title_zh: ZAYA1-8B 技术报告
items.summary: ZAYA1-8B is a reasoning-focused mixture-of-experts model with 8B total and 700M active parameters whose core pretraining, midtraining and supervised fine-tuning ran on a full-stack AMD platform; it matches or exceeds DeepSeek-R1-0528 on several math and coding benchmarks. A test-time method called Markovian RSA lifts it to 91.9% on AIME'25 and 89.6% on HMMT'25 while carrying forward only a 4K-token reasoning tail.

items.title: Agent Skills
items.title_zh: Agent Skills：让编码智能体不再跳过规范、测试与评审
items.summary: A post on Addy Osmani's blog, discussed on Hacker News, argues that AI coding agents take the shortest path to done by skipping specs, tests and reviews that keep software reliable at scale, and proposes Agent Skills as the remedy.

items.title: AlphaEvolve: How our Gemini-powered coding agent is scaling impact across fields
items.title_zh: AlphaEvolve：Gemini 驱动的编码智能体如何跨领域扩大影响
items.summary: Google DeepMind describes how AlphaEvolve's Gemini-powered algorithms are driving impact across business, infrastructure and science.

items.title: How frontier firms are pulling ahead
items.title_zh: 前沿企业如何拉开差距
items.summary: OpenAI's B2B Signals research examines how leading enterprises deepen AI adoption, scale Codex-powered agentic workflows and build what the company describes as durable competitive advantage.

items.title: Adaptive Parallel Reasoning: The Next Paradigm in Efficient Inference Scaling
items.title_zh: 自适应并行推理：高效推理扩展的下一个范式
items.summary: A Berkeley AI Research overview surveys adaptive parallel reasoning, in which a reasoning model decides for itself when to decompose independent subtasks, how many concurrent threads to spawn and how to coordinate them. The post combines a landscape survey with the authors' perspective and notes that a co-author helped lead ThreadWeaver, one of the methods discussed.

items.title: Running Codex safely at OpenAI
items.title_zh: 在 OpenAI 安全地运行 Codex
items.summary: OpenAI describes how it runs Codex securely using sandboxing, approvals, network policies and agent-native telemetry to support safe and compliant adoption of coding agents.

items.title: Show HN: Git for AI Agents
items.title_zh: Show HN：面向 AI 智能体的 Git
items.summary: The Show HN launch presents re_gent, an open-source version-control tool that records what an AI coding agent did, supports blaming lines back to a prompt and rewinding, and currently works with Claude Code.

items.title: Teaching Claude Why
items.title_zh: 教 Claude 明辨缘由
items.summary: An Anthropic research post describes work on reducing agentic misalignment in Claude, framed as teaching the model why.

items.title: An AI coding agent, used to write code, needs to reduce your maintenance costs
items.title_zh: 用来写代码的 AI 编码智能体，必须降低你的维护成本
items.summary: James Shore argues that an AI coding agent must reduce maintenance costs in proportion to the speed it adds, or teams trade a temporary boost for permanent indenture; the Hacker News discussion drew 380 points and 108 comments.

items.title: Gemini API File Search is now multimodal
items.title_zh: Gemini API File Search 现已支持多模态
items.summary: Google says updates to the Gemini API File Search tool make it easier for developers to build efficient, multimodal file retrieval systems; the Hacker News submission drew 156 points and 46 comments.

items.title: OpenAI and PwC collaborate to reimagine the office of the CFO
items.title_zh: OpenAI 与 PwC 合作重塑 CFO 办公室
items.summary: OpenAI and PwC are partnering to help enterprises use AI agents to automate finance workflows, improve forecasting, strengthen controls and modernize the CFO function.

items.title: Parloa builds service agents customers want to talk to
items.title_zh: Parloa 打造客户愿意对话的服务智能体
items.summary: Parloa uses OpenAI models to power scalable, voice-driven customer service agents that enterprises can design, simulate and deploy for reliable real-time interactions.
